judge.rationale: The candidate correctly accumulates token usage across all provider rounds in `chatOrchestrator.ts` and handles missing round usage cleanly without mutating input objects or producing `NaN`. All acceptance criteria from the ticket are satisfied, including updating the specs (with accurate line-number references), CHANGELOG, and `CLAUDE.md`. Compared to the reference, the candidate goes slightly further on the ticket's prompt to make the type unambiguous by introducing a backwards-compatible `TotalUsage` type alias in `src/types/ai.ts`, whereas the reference only renamed the parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata`. The only minor downsides are leaving `.lore/dod.md` in the diff and duplicating tests across both `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` and a new `chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` file.
